objective: Build an O(1)-memory-per-query oracle that APPROXIMATES AN IDEAL RANDOM PERMUTATION (fresh random key per trial -- the opposite of BATCH-014's fixed-key RC-D), and rerun BATCH-009's cipher-substitution comparison at decisive exposure (2^30, where ~14 events are expected under BATCH-009's measured rate), closing the perm128 memory-architecture gap named in EV-AES-837cd8.
headline: THE EXCESS STAYS ABSENT. Both arms read OUTCOME-A'' under the preregistered decision rule: M1 (fresh-key-per-trial 16-round SipRound-Feistel substitute at matched exposure 2^30) read 1 hit against the matched live 5-round AES arm's 14 (p=9.765625e-4 exact, R=1.0, Garwood 95% CI [0.025, 5.572] containing 1, rate ratio 14.0 CI [2.13, 592.0]); M2 (same oracle, 8x exposure 2^33) read 10 hits against its own ~8-event analytic null (R=1.25, 95% CI [0.599, 2.299] containing 1; exposure-weighted test vs the live arm p=5.753e-8), far below the ~112 hits an AES-level rate extrapolated to 8x would predict. The cipher-substitution absence (BATCH-009 OUTCOME-A, BATCH-014 OUTCOME-A') therefore replicates at decisive exposure on an independent, O(1)-memory, ideal-APPROXIMATING (not merely non-ideal) substitute with per-trial fresh-permutation semantics. Additionally, the matched live arm reproduced BATCH-009's P1-R5-PAIR reading EXACTLY -- 14 hits, identical hit-trial indices, identical plaintext-stream digests -- verified field-by-field against the immutable source file.
plain_statement_first_line: OUTCOME-A'' on both preregistered comparisons: the r=5 excess did NOT reappear under the fresh-key-per-trial ideal-approximating Feistel substitute at 2^30 or 2^33.

frozen_comparator.note: P1-R5-PAIR (BATCH-009, EV-AES-e4c091 OBS-B9-3) is NOT recomputed here; every value below was read DIRECTLY from the immutable run artifact before any run of this task (per the card's standing practice: verify from source file, never from citation).

construction.kind: fresh-key-per-trial balanced Feistel PRP, 16 rounds, 64-bit halves, SipRound-based round function (SipHash-2-4 compression round: add/rotate/xor only)
construction.fresh_key_mechanism: two consecutive splitmix64 draws per trial from a dedicated per-thread key stream (seed ^ armid*0x517CC1B727220A95 ^ (t+1)*0x6A09E667F3BCC908), per-trial subkey derivation on the worker stack, NO global key state (contrast RC-D's global fixed RK[])

fresh_key_verification.within_thread_proof: splitmix64 state advances by an odd constant on a single 2^64-cycle and its output mix is a bijection, so consecutive 128-bit key pairs cannot repeat within 2^64 draws >> 2^33 trials
fresh_key_verification.per_arm_evidence: each measurement arm JSON logs its first 4 per-trial keys per thread (all 8 sampled keys in M1 pairwise distinct, verified) and an order-sensitive digest over ALL drawn keys (key_stream_digest)

stream_separation.note: deterministic circular-shift exclusion computed at run time, matching BATCH-009's stream_gap practice

construction.memory_per_query: O(1) -- direct algebraic evaluation, RK on the worker stack, no stored pair table; measured peak RSS of every measurement arm ~2 MB (budget_stamps/timing files), vs perm128's 8.590 GB dom+rng cost at 2^26 (EV-AES-837cd8 OBS-B12-5)
construction.statistical_quality_argument: src/CONSTRUCTION_JUSTIFICATION.md -- per-trial 4-query transcript regime (resampling keeps every trial at q=4), Luby-Rackoff 4-round SPRP floor for inverse-query transcripts, Patarin-type concrete bound of order q^4/2^{2n} = ~2^-120 per trial at q=4 n=64 (union bound << 2^-100 over 2^33 trials), round-function step disclosed as the standard working assumption (not a proof), support-size caveat stated, all external citations marked provenance 'recalled' per AGENTS.md rule 9
construction.independence_audit: src/INDEPENDENCE_AUDIT.md -- oracle zone shares zero tables/constants/code with AES's S-box/MixColumns/ShiftRows/key schedule (grep G1 exit 1), zero vocabulary shared in either direction with yoyo_sbox_v2-v4 (except the disclosed plaintext-digest bookkeeping fragment), perm128, or RC-D's oracle; RC-D's fmix64 round function NOT reused (only cosmetic grep hit is the keycheck set-hash constant, disclosed); grep record runs/grep_independence.txt
construction.differs_from_RC-D_as_required: RC-D (EV-AES-dec938) fixed one key for all trials to test structuredness; this task draws a fresh key every trial to approximate a fresh random permutation per trial, matching perm128's own semantics. Different round function (SipRound add/rotl/xor vs murmur3-fmix64 multiply/xorshift), different key schedule constants, different key-stream architecture. Verified opposite property: RC-D verified determinism; this task verified freshness.

exposure_decision.methodology: measured per-query cost BEFORE committing: selfcheck rate probes (2^20 each oracle, 2 threads) then a 2^26 calibration arm; linear extrapolation; committed only after margin >= 600s against the binding stop -- per PREREGISTRATION.md section 3
exposure_decision.target_reached: 2^30 for BOTH the matched live arm and the substitute arm, AND 2^33 (8x) for the substitute arm -- the campaign's decisive-exposure target for this comparison (EV-AES-837cd8 unresolved_confounds) reached in full, no shortfall

Same non-independence class as BATCH-009's N1/N2 (EV-AES-e4c091 OBS-B9-5); reported and compared separately, never pooled.

unexpected_observations: M1 read EXACTLY 1 hit at 2^30 -- the same count BATCH-009's perm128 ideal arm N1-IDEAL-P30 read at the same exposure (their hit at trial [0,128282052], this one at [1,270788492]; different trial indices, so not the same event). Recorded per rule 8 as a coincidence of counts between two structurally different oracles at the same exposure, with no interpretation attached.

L1 reproduced not only P1-R5-PAIR's count (14) but its exact hit-trial indices, whist, thread seeds, and plaintext-stream digests -- expected given byte-identical stream/cipher/key, but noted as the strongest possible form of harness-equivalence verification.

M2 read 10 hits against an ~8-event null (R=1.25, z ~ 0.7): slightly above its analytic null, comfortably inside its CI. Recorded plainly; the decision rule keys on the CI and the exact test, both satisfied.
One trivial swap was excluded in M2 (nontrivial = 2^33 - 1) and none in M1/L1; matches the campaign's ~2^-32-per-trial trivial-swap rate. No other anomalies.
boundaries: This is a measurement at one probe geometry (amask=1, smask=1), one seed/armid (531001/1), one live AES key (bdf3823182ad657dab3d556b3886ba72), trials 2^30 and 2^33, one machine, one 16-round SipRound-Feistel construction. It does not generalize to other Feistel round counts, round functions, keys, seeds, or geometries.

The construction's closeness to ideal is a WORKING ASSUMPTION backed by the named argument in src/CONSTRUCTION_JUSTIFICATION.md (per-trial q=4 transcript regime, Luby-Rackoff/Patarin-type bounds with citations marked 'recalled') plus the empirical sanity battery -- NOT a proof of indistinguishability from ideal. The round-function step is the standard heuristic, not a theorem established here.

M1 and M2 are NOT independent replicates (same seed/armid/key-stream; M2's trial stream is a superset prefix of M1's, verified by hit inclusion) -- reported separately, never pooled, per EV-AES-e4c091 OBS-B9-5.

The M2-vs-live comparison is asymmetric-exposure by design (live at 2^30, M2 at 2^33); it is a higher-precision reading of the substitute arm's own rate, not an independent re-measurement of the live arm.

This record establishes absence for this ONE ideal-approximating construction; it does not resolve whether absence holds for all ideal-approximating O(1)-memory constructions (the next untested axis), and per the task's prohibitions it assigns no evidence strength, no hypothesis status, and recommends no promotion.
It does NOT establish that the r=5 excess is real, does not identify a mechanism, and does not support any claim about AES or any cryptographic scheme.

Toy tier only: reduced-round AES-shaped SPN probe geometry, one machine, no crypto-scale, medium-scale, affected-scheme, or asymptotic claim made or implied. No comparison to published cryptanalysis in either direction.

Session and implementation independence only, no model independence: this task resolves to one model under standing basis 0137a051eb5828789eb267fa83c8278086578d4c. Nothing here counts toward a closure quorum.

The matched live arm was run by THIS instrument (rc8probe.c's AES code copied byte-for-byte), not by BATCH-009's yoyo_sbox_v4; equivalence is established by the exact reproduction of all P1-R5-PAIR fields including hit indices and stream digests (harness_equivalence_verification block), plus EV-AES-e4c091's independent rc8probe-vs-v3 bit-exact equivalence finding.
